# R2 independent adversarial review

Result: `CLEAR_AFTER_R2_REPAIR_01`.

The review initially found D2-T admission, independent posterior verification,
finite-axis causality, canonical preregistration binding, aggregation, and Gate
defects. One direct repair batch corrected them before any confirmatory state
was created.

Verified final properties:

- SCAN admission requires frozen `B_S=565` plus `B_C=138` ticks and the fixed
  horizon is 1600 ticks.
- The finite library is exactly `3 process × 3 cost × 8 density × 4 variance =
  288` worlds. Candidate quality, duplicates, grouping and hard negatives have
  transition/policy-visible consequences.
- The posterior has a separate brute-force likelihood oracle and an incremental
  Bayes-update check; it has no actual-execution-world argument.
- R2 namespaces are independent; history has no seed/world/RNG/future field.
- Legacy path, hash and seed identities are blacklisted. Tests and development
  smoke do not import confirmatory materialization.
- The one-shot runner accepts only the canonical freeze-bound preregistration,
  includes B0/B1/B2/B3/B4/M1 metrics, and implements paired macro/median,
  regime deltas, best-simple selection including Ratio, and the frozen
  sparse/bursty/heterogeneous-cost neighborhood conditions.
- Deterministic confirmatory stratification guarantees at least 12 observations
  in each required density-bin family cell once a future authorized run begins.

No confirmatory runner was executed; no new confirmatory seed or result exists.

# Independent adversarial review — final verdict

Verdict: **SAFE TO LAUNCH THE FROZEN E1 CONFIRMATORY COORDINATOR**, subject to
separate operational authorization for the explicit one-shot command.

The reviewer first identified and required remediation of: incomplete
universe/hash validation, an altered Gate, unrestricted resume inputs,
unauthenticated raw truth/regime, raw-write/ledger crash recovery, derived
publication recovery, and formal decision-artifact publication recovery.

The final review verified canonical preregistration/root binding, R2/E1 freeze
checks, the literal frozen R2 Gate reconstruction, sealed 512 × 9 identity and
seed/world binding, atomic raw reconciliation, atomic derived and decision
bundles, explicit fixture isolation, 53 passing focused toy tests, clean E1
freeze hashes, and absence of a confirmatory attempt root. No confirmatory
command was run; this is protocol-safety evidence, not an efficacy result.
